character_functions.covering_map: the point (component, t) of an arc covers the point of G's component of the same id at the angle omega = 2 pi t mod 2 pi (folded into G's range), a point x of an atom G's point x mod pi; a vector family's character is Rotation's, its variable phi = 2 psi

irrep_families.degeneracy: one irrep of dimension 2j+1 for every half-odd j >= 1/2

matrices.basis: spherical: the kets |j,m> of D^(j,+1) (double/CONVENTIONS.md section 26.1), m = j, j-1, ..., -j; partner mu = j - m + 1

euler.relation: for U = R~_z(alpha) R~_y(beta) R~_z(gamma) (the lifts of section 21.1, product in the order of SU(2) matrices), D^j(U)_{m'm} = exp(-i m' alpha) d^j_{m'm}(beta) exp(-i m gamma), d^j the Wigner d matrix of SU2's wigner_d

su2.relation: hat D(U, eps)_{m'm} = p^[eps = -1] conj(D^j(U)_{m m'}) (double/CONVENTIONS.md section 26.1), D^j(U)_{m'm} = sqrt((j+m')! (j-m')! (j+m)! (j-m)!) sum_k a^k b^(j+m'-k) c^(j+m-k) d^(k-m-m') / (k! (j+m'-k)! (j+m-k)! (k-m-m')!), over the k for which every factorial argument is >= 0; U = [[a, b], [c, d]] in SU(2); D^j(U) is the matrix of U on the polynomials u^(j+m) v^(j-m) / sqrt((j+m)! (j-m)!) under u -> a u + c v, v -> b u + d v, and D^(1/2)(U) = U; p the parity of the family (+1 for Dhalf and Dhalfg, -1 for Dhalfu)

matrices.note: x is psi = pi t: C~(x) stands for the class of the lifts R~_v(2x) about any axis v; entries gives the matrix on the representatives about z, where it is diagonal; general_element gives it on every element

rules: D^(j1) (x) D^(j2) = sum_{J=|j1-j2|}^{j1+j2} D^(J), each J once: SU(2) is simply reducible
<j1 m1 j2 m2 | J M> in the Condon-Shortley convention (Varshalovich, Moskalev and Khersonskii 1988, 8.1.1): real, zero unless M = m1 + m2, and <j1 j1 j2 J-j1 | J J> > 0
C[(i,k), mu] = <j1 m1 j2 m2 | J M> with i = j1 - m1 + 1, k = j2 - m2 + 1, mu = J - M + 1 (m descending), on the kets |j,m> of D^(j,+1) (double/CONVENTIONS.md section 26.1)

closed form (van der Waerden, Racah; VMK 8.2.1 eq. 3), at integer and half-integer j: <j1 m1 j2 m2 | J M> = delta_{M,m1+m2} sqrt((2J+1) (j1+j2-J)! (j1-j2+J)! (-j1+j2+J)! / (j1+j2+J+1)!) sqrt((j1+m1)! (j1-m1)! (j2+m2)! (j2-m2)! (J+M)! (J-M)!) sum_z (-1)^z / (z! (j1+j2-J-z)! (j1-m1-z)! (j2+m2-z)! (J-j2+m1+z)! (J-j1-m2+z)!), over the z for which every factorial argument is >= 0
symmetries (VMK 8.4): <j1 m1 j2 m2|J M> = (-1)^{j1+j2-J} <j2 m2 j1 m1|J M> = (-1)^{j1+j2-J} <j1 -m1 j2 -m2|J -M>

the products j1 <= j2 <= 10 with j1 or j2 half-integer are in one file per 2j1, data/clebsch_gordan/SU2/<NN>.json with NN = 2j1 in two digits (00 to 19); the products of two integer j are SO3's (vector_products)

jj_configurations.rule: Lambda^n of the spinor level L, n = 0, ..., dim L: chi = e_n(g), n e_n = sum_{k=1}^{n} (-1)^(k-1) e_(n-k) chi_L(g^k); Lambda^(d-n)(L) = Lambda^n(L) (x) Lambda^d(L)

closed_form.structure_theorem: D^(J,p)|SU(2) = D^(J) (Pin^-(3): D^(J,p)): the 2J+1 kets |J,m> are the partners of one block, mu = J - m + 1

continuous.text: D^(J) | 2C_inf = sum_{n=1/2..J} (1E_n + 2E_n): |J,m> spans 1E_m for m > 0 and 2E_(-m) for m < 0
D^(J) | 2D_inf = sum_{n=1/2..J} E_n: the kets |J,-n>, |J,n> span E_n

families.text: D^(J) | 2C_N = sum_{m=-J..J} G(q), q = m mod N (0 < q < N); G(q) = 1E_q if q < N/2, A_(N/2) if q = N/2, 2E_(N-q) if q > N/2
D^(J) | 2D_N = sum_{m=1/2..J} G(q), q = m mod N (0 < q < N); G(q) = E_m with m = min(q, N - q) if q != N/2, 1E_(N/2) + 2E_(N/2) if q = N/2

subduction_rules.sections: a section C_N (N odd) is restricted as its preimage 2C_N, each spinor irrep of 2C_N renamed by the section's record (double/CONVENTIONS.md section 27)

wigner_d.d_formula: d^J_{m'm}(beta) = sum_sigma (-1)^{m'-m+sigma} sqrt((J+m')! (J-m')! (J+m)! (J-m)!) / ((J+m-sigma)! sigma! (m'-m+sigma)! (J-m'-sigma)!) c^{2J+m-m'-2sigma} s^{m'-m+2sigma}, c = cos(beta/2), s = sin(beta/2), over the sigma for which every factorial argument is >= 0
wigner_d.d_symbol: d^J_{m'm}(beta) = <J m'| exp(-i beta J_y) |J m> (Varshalovich, Moskalev and Khersonskii 1988, section 4.3)
